cards.title: The Vanity Trap
cards.body:
Most startups track **vanity metrics**: registered accounts, page views, or total downloads. These numbers go up even when the product is bleeding users.

A true **North Star Metric (NSM)** measures the moment your customer actually extracts value from your product.

cards.question: What is Airbnb's legendary North Star Metric?
cards.explanation: 'Nights booked' captures value for both guests (staying) and hosts (earning). Both sides of the marketplace are represented.

cards.title: Key Takeaway
cards.body: Align every cross-functional sprint around driving your single North Star Metric.
